speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
text: asked the Minister for Health after the lifting of the circuit breaker on 1 June (a) what measures will remain for visitation of residents living in nursing homes; (b) whether swab tests will be conducted for seniors and staff in day care centres; and (c) which phase will senior activity centres be classified under for resumption of their operations.

speaker: Mr Deputy Speaker
text: Can Senior Minister of State answer within three minutes?

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Seniors are more vulnerable to COVID-19 infection as they develop more severe symptoms if infected.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: We have thus taken a more cautious approach to the resumption of senior-centric activities when the circuit breaker ended.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Nursing homes will continue to facilitate interactions between seniors and their loved ones via phone and video calls.
